name: Ring of Summoning Affinity (Protean)
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 219
Aura faint conjuration [chaos] CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 7,200 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring is made from an opalescent material that is never the same color twice. If the wearer can cast summon monster spells, the wearer adds voidwormB2 to the 3rd-level list of monsters she can summon with those spells, adds naunetB2 to the 6th-level list, and adds imenteshB2 to the 9th-level list. Also, once per day on command the wearer can use this ring to summon a voidworm, as if by the summon monster III spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, planar ally or planar binding, creator must be chaotic neutral; Cost 3,600 gp
